identitySignals: Name matches a registered nonprofit: 'Spanish Speaking Unity Council of Alameda County, Inc' (dba The Unity Council), EIN 94-1670490 (GuideStar)
Headquartered in Oakland, CA (Fruitvale neighborhood), in the OUSD service area

The Unity Council's website and GuideStar profile describe Head Start and Early Head Start early childhood education programs, matching the OUSD subcontract for its 'Early Childhood Education Department' funded by CDE child care programs
The Unity Council's Facebook page mentions a partnership with OUSD (Oakland Unified), and the agenda's dba name 'The Unity Council' matches the GuideStar and website name
research.notes: The California Secretary of State entity number and SAM.gov UEI were not confirmed on a fetched registry page, so they are left null. A search snippet from HigherGov listed a UEI, but the fetched page did not show it. The agenda gives no city. The match rests on the name, the Oakland location, and the early-childhood programs. The legal name is copied from GuideStar, which omits the period after 'Inc'.

profile.legalName: Spanish Speaking Unity Council of Alameda County, Inc
profile.summary: The Unity Council is a nonprofit based in the Fruitvale neighborhood of Oakland. It works to promote social equity and build strong communities. Its programs include early childhood education (Head Start and Early Head Start), affordable housing, workforce and financial services, and senior services.

review.notes: This is the same organization OUSD contracts with. GuideStar lists the legal name 'Spanish Speaking Unity Council of Alameda County, Inc', EIN 94-1670490, and an Oakland (Fruitvale) address, and it names CCTR among the early childhood program's funding sources, which matches the OUSD funding source. The Unity Council's website and contact page confirm the summary, the neutral nonprofit description, the general phone number, the admin@ business email, the address and the website.
